##### Project general facts

The LX by Mulk is a boutique commercial tower developed by Mulk Properties, a multinational conglomerate headquartered in Sharjah's Hamriyah Free Zone. The building features two basement levels, a ground floor, six office floors, and a rooftop, offering a well-structured and efficient layout. Located in the fast-growing Arjan district, the project stands out with its modern architecture, clean lines, and integration of natural light and greenery, creating a refined and professional business environment. The tower comprises 71 boutique office units, available as single offices, half floors, and full floors, positioned as a considered alternative to typical corporate floor plates for growing businesses.

Shared amenities include a double-height lift lobby, a reception area, five high-speed elevators with well-planned service areas, and 234 parking spaces with valet parking. At the base of the tower, two retail outlets are positioned to serve the surrounding community.

Interiors feature floor-to-ceiling windows, premium finishes, and integrated greenery across balanced, clean-lined layouts. Most offices include a private balcony. Units are delivered shell and core, allowing for complete customization, and multiple units can be combined to create larger office spaces as needed. The building is complemented by a double-height lobby, five high-speed elevators, and a range of services designed to enhance convenience and daily operations.


##### Location description and benefits

Arjan, situated in the heart of Dubailand, is a rapidly growing community known for its family-friendly environment and excellent connectivity. Developed with sustainability in mind, Arjan features a mix of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a well-rounded destination for living and recreation. The neighborhood is home to notable landmarks such as the iconic Dubai Miracle Garden, one of the largest floral installations in the world, and the Dubai Butterfly Garden, which houses thousands of exotic butterfly species.

The community offers a mix of modern residential developments with contemporary architecture and thoughtfully designed apartments, often surrounded by lush green landscapes. Arjan places a strong emphasis on outdoor living, with parks, jogging tracks, and landscaped areas providing residents with ample opportunities for relaxation and leisure. Retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options are conveniently located, ensuring that daily needs are easily met.

Its strategic location provides excellent connectivity to Dubai’s key areas. Arjan is just a short drive from Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, and Al Barsha, with major road networks like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road ensuring easy access. This combination of tranquility, convenience, and modernity makes Arjan a sought-after destination for residents seeking a balanced urban lifestyle in Dubai.
